messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager firing: synthetic check 'edge-probe/us-east-1' crossed failure threshold (5 consecutive 503s). PagerDuty incident INC-4721 created. auto-escalate=on

pagerduty-bot: INC-4721 - https://pagerduty.example.com/incidents/INC-4721 — triggered by monitor 'synth-edge/healthcheck' — urgent. Acknowledge to stop further escalations.

maria_k: acking on-call. looking now. thanks for the alert. :white_check_mark:

devon: I can see a surge of 503s in the synthetic run logs. quick grep from the probe runner:

```
GET /health -> 503 (envoy) x5
ts=2026-03-14T21:12:31Z host=edge-us-east-1-1 svc=frontend proto=HTTP/1.1 code=503 reason=upstream-reset
```

maria_k: interesting — traces show envoy returning 503 with upstream reset, not application 5xx. likely a rate-limit or upstream connection exhaustion. checking envoy metrics now.

cheng_sre: pinging infra team — could this be a burst from the new routing policy that went out in canary earlier? @infra-bot any config flips in last 30m?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: config-change: route-weight-adjustment v2026-03-14_20:50 deployed to edge-us-east-1 canary (10%). change-id: cfg-8812.

devon: that matches. the canary bumped traffic for a subset of prefixes to the new upstream pool. looks like the upstream pool nodes hit connection limits and envoy started short-circuiting with 503s.

maria_k: mitigation plan — 1) pause the canary routing change (rollback cfg-8812), 2) scale upstream pool + restart one envoy shard if needed, 3) keep PD incident open until stable for 10m. I can roll back canary now if infra approves.

cheng_sre: approved. maria, please rollback and post the command you run. I'll watch metrics and handle PD escalation if needed. katie, heads up for handoff in two hours if we don't fully resolve.

maria_k: running rollback command now:

```
infractl routes set-weight --region us-east-1 --change-id cfg-8812 --action rollback
```

maria_k: rollback submitted. infractl returned change accepted, targetting canary endpoints.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: cfg-8812 rollback initiated at 2026-03-14T21:18:03Z. progress: 0 -> 100% within 15s.

devon: metrics: 503s dropping immediately on edge-us-east-1, request success rate back to baseline for the next 3 probe runs. nice.

maria_k: restarting one envoy pod to clear connection pools (rolling restart): kubectl rollout restart deployment/envoy-edge-us-east-1 -n infra --grace-period=30.

cheng_sre: good. monitoring logs and tracing. any customer-facing impact? SLO alerting?

maria_k: early estimate: transient error window ~ 7 minutes from first failure to full rollback. synthetic failure only; no related customer support tickets reported yet. we've not seen 500s from backend services, only envoy 503s. marking severity: sev2 for now (potential customer impact but mitigated quickly).

katie_oncall: I'm taking secondary. if this regresses after handoff I'll escalate to platform leads. what's the postmortem owner?

maria_k: assigning postmortem to devon (root cause triage) and cheng for infra follow-up. I'll add remediation items to the incident doc: tighten canary ramp, add upstream connection headroom check, and improved synthetic probe alerting to detect envoy-origin 503s.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4721 acknowledged by maria_k at 2026-03-14T21:18:45Z. Status: acknowledged.

devon: brief notes for incident doc: cause: canary routing change (cfg-8812) increased pressure on new upstream pool; symptom: envoy returning 503 upstream-reset; mitigation: rollback canary, restart envoy, scale upstream nodes; impact: transient synthetic check failures, no confirmed customer errors.

maria_k: handing off to @katie_oncall for 07:00 UTC rotation (I'm OOO after 22:00 UTC). katie, I pinned the incident doc link and added the quick mitigation commands.

katie_oncall: thanks — I'll keep monitoring for 30m. if probes stay green, we can close after 30m stable and add postmortem action items. please make sure the action items have owners so we can follow up.

maria_k: closing note: probe runs green x6, no further PD pages. moving to resolved soon, leaving PD incident open for now for traceability. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-4721 status changed to resolved at 2026-03-14T21:27:02Z by maria_k.

maria_k: resolved. will sync with devon/cheng for RCA tomorrow. thanks all for quick triage. :heart:
